import re
import sys

values = {}

assignment_re = re.compile(r"^\s*([A-Za-z]+)\s*<-\s*(.*?)\s*;\s*$")
update_re = re.compile(r"\(\s*([A-Za-z]+)\s*\+\s*(\d+)\s*\)\s*mod\s*100")

for line in sys.stdin:
    line = line.strip()
    if not line or line.startswith("//"):
        continue

    match = assignment_re.match(line)
    if not match:
        continue

    name, expression = match.groups()
    update = update_re.fullmatch(expression)

    if update:
        variable, increment = update.groups()
        values[name] = (values[variable] + int(increment)) % 100
    else:
        values[name] = int(expression)

order = list("abcdefghijklmnop") + ["TMP"]
print("; ".join(f"{name} ?= {values[name]}" for name in order) + ";")
